interpretation: Current TradRadar and Kodexius observations are 1 hour 51 minutes apart but still have different venue and contract coverage; their 2.37x ratio is a data-quality discrepancy, not a single synchronized market-wide OI truth.
TradRadar covers seven venues and includes MEXC, Gate and Bitget; Kodexius lists seven contracts across Binance, Bybit, Hyperliquid, OKX and HTX, including different USDT/USDC contracts.
Funding is not uniform: Kodexius shows Bybit negative while Binance, Hyperliquid, OKX and HTX are positive.

crypto_keyhole.methodology: Issuer-published holdings files; day-over-day XRP holdings delta. Daily total is partial until all daily-collected issuers publish. No forward-fill or estimate.
crypto_keyhole.exclusions: Grayscale GXRP not collected daily due automated-reader bot challenge; quarterly SEC holdings only. REX-Osprey XRPR not counted because it holds part of coins through other ETPs and its direct-holdings file is not total holdings/flow.

xrp_insights.tracked_universe: 6 US spot XRP ETFs plus BITW XRP sleeve
xrp_insights.methodology: Issuer holdings day-over-day delta. flow_status separates computed, initial and excluded; row_status separates settled, provisional and reconstructed. GXRP daily flows excluded over Sep 2-28 capture gap; XRPR treatment differs from CryptoKeyhole.

interpretation: CryptoKeyhole's Nov 2 partial is -3,339 XRP across 3/4 funds, not a complete daily total.
CryptoKeyhole's four daily funds and XRP Insights' six spot funds plus BITW are different universes. Their Oct 30 holdings totals differ by about 119.8M XRP; this is not automatically a data error.
XRP Insights' +3.390M XRP five-day total includes BITW's XRP sleeve and uses flow-excluded funds as no contribution; its Nov 2 row is provisional.
ETF holdings delta is not identical to unhedged investor conviction, exchange spot buying or secondary-market volume.

coinbase_liquidity.source: CoinGecko 2026 Crypto Liquidity on CEXes Report
coinbase_liquidity.method: 60-day public-API order-book snapshots of the most liquid spot ticker for each asset/exchange; median daily depth.
findings: Binance had the largest XRP depth at the market price.
Coinbase surpassed Binance at approximately ±$0.0025 (0.1%) and retained the strongest median depth through the ±$0.025 (about 2%) range.
On September 1 Coinbase had roughly $8M combined depth through most of the ±2% interval; Crypto.com surpassed it beyond ±2%.

On July 31 the XRP escrow unlock coincided with about $7M additional buy-side liquidity on Coinbase and Crypto.com beyond ±1%, while overall depth remained near the daily median; consistent with order repositioning, not proof of new capital.
On August 23 Coinbase displayed unusually large sell-side orders at +$0.0025 and +$0.0125, pushing cumulative sell-side liquidity above $5M.
coinbase_liquidity.interpretation: Coinbase has a documented tactical near-mid and median depth-range liquidity strength; Binance remains deepest at the touch. This supports an execution/market-quality role, not price control, guaranteed executable size or proof of a causal XRP price effect.

data_policy: Never average asynchronous OI provider totals.
Persist provider timestamp, retrieval timestamp, exchange set, contract set, quote currency, unit and raw snapshot hash.
ETF daily flow is valid only when the selected fund universe is complete; provisional rows remain separate.
Use holdings deltas only with issuer-file provenance and fund-level inclusion/exclusion rules.
Order-book depth is a cancellable snapshot, not executed volume or committed capital.
